title: refactor(app-shell)!: retire the 54 root-entry exports that nothing outside the package names
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9WDHUTc91Ru3wKHsnWYaas9)_

Part of #25922 (step 1 only: the zero-reference exports and the architecture guide; the package split and the designer-strings migration stay with the card).

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) (removes published exports from `@object-ui/app-shell`; the seat records a TIER_DEFAULT contract review before landing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` stops publishing 54 names that no file in this repository outside the package names. Every defining module stays; only the root entry changes. The entry goes from 261 names to 208 (`main` added `InvitationSignUpPrompt` meanwhile). One comment count in the entry follows (`11 TYPE-ONLY re-exports` is now 9).
- `ui/docs/app-shell-extraction-guide.md` is rewritten to describe the package that ships: directory sizes, the groups of names the entry publishes, its load-time registrations, its dependencies and peer dependencies, and its three consumers here (`apps/console`, `examples/console-starter`, `examples/byo-backend-console`). The six compiled `tsx` usage blocks are kept byte for byte.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/chrome/toast-helpers.ts`: its usage docblock imported `toastWithUndo` from `@object-ui/app-shell`, which this change makes false; it now names the module.
- `.changeset/25922-app-shell-retire-unreferenced-exports.md`: `patch`, a **BREAKING** banner, a FROM → TO line for every retired name and the ADR-0087 marker (see Acceptance notes: that gate is red).

## How "zero references" was measured (main `fbb75998`)

1. Every name the root entry exports, read from `src/index.ts` with its `as` aliases resolved: 261 names (the card counted 262 at `7981384`).
2. For each name: `git grep -l -w -F NAME -- ui packages apps ':!ui/packages/app-shell/'`. Zero files means zero references. This counts every tracked file of every kind: code, tests, docs, changelogs, ADRs.
3. Positive control: `SchemaRenderer` is named in 1,088 files outside the package.
4. Result: 57 names with zero hits. Three are kept because the package's own README imports them in its examples, and `ui/scripts/check-readme-exports.mjs` reds when a README imports a missing export: `SignUpOffer`, `RuntimeBranding`, `studioOrgScopePath`. The other 54 are retired.
5. Over the whole tree instead of `ui/ packages/ apps/` the count is 56: `AssistantEditorContext` is also named in `docs/adr/0037-live-canvas-draft-preview.md`. It is retired, because the ADR names the module path (`app-shell/src/assistant/assistantBus.ts`), and that module still exports it.

## Removed from the root entry (54)

- `src/providers/ExpressionProvider`: `useExpressionContext`, `ExpressionContextValue` (type)
- `src/hooks/useUrlOverlay`: `UseUrlOverlayOptions` (type), `UrlOverlayControls` (type)
- `src/hooks/useSettleSignal`: `SettleSignalState` (type)
- `src/observability/settleSignal`: `isIdle`, `ObjectUiGlobal` (type)
- `src/hooks/useRecentItems`: `RecentItemInput` (type), `RecentTextItem` (type)
- `src/hooks/useRecentItemLabel`: `RecentItemLabelResolver` (type)
- `src/utils/index`: `isOverrideOnlyViewer`, `actionAdmittedByOverride`, `bypassedApproverNames`, `DeclaredHomeApp` (type)
- `src/hooks/useAiSurface`: `AiSurfaceState` (type)
- `src/layout/index`: `PreviewBadgeProps` (type)
- `src/chrome/index`: `RedirectWithSplashProps` (type), `toastWithUndo`, `ToastWithUndoOptions` (type)
- `src/runtime-config`: `getCloudBase`, `getBrandColor`, `isRuntimeConfigInitialised`, `RuntimeFeatures` (type)
- `src/views/index`: `RecordFormPageProps` (type), `DeclaredActionsBarProps` (type)
- `src/hooks/index`: `addNavigationItem`, `removeNavigationItems`, `renameNavigationItems`, `navigationEqual`, `generateNavId`
- `src/context/index`: `CommandPaletteContextValue` (type)
- `src/console/auth/signUpOffer`: `SignUpOfferContext` (type)
- `src/hooks/useChatConversation`: `HydratedUIMessage` (type)
- `src/services/componentRegistry`: `listAppComponents`, `urlSegmentsToComponentRef`, `AppComponentRegistryEntry` (type)
- `src/views/metadata-admin/PageShell`: `MetadataPageShell` (alias of `PageShell`)
- `src/views/metadata-admin/registry`: `listMetadataResources`
- `src/views/metadata-admin/useMetadata`: `useMetadataTypes`, `useTypesIndex`, `matchesQuery`
- `src/views/metadata-admin/preview-registry`: `MetadataPreviewProps` (type)
- `src/views/metadata-admin/inspector-registry`: `MetadataInspectorProps` (type)
- `src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface`: `StudioDesignSurfaceProps` (type)
- `src/views/studio-design/studio-canvas-preview`: `getStudioCanvasPreview`, `listStudioCanvasPreviewTypes`, `StudioObjectRecordsCanvas`, `StudioCanvasPreview` (type), `StudioCanvasPreviewProps` (type)
- `src/assistant/assistantBus`: `useAssistant`, `useRegisterAssistantEditor`, `requestAssistantOpen`, `AssistantEditorContext` (type), `AssistantEditorField` (type)

## Tests

All runs on head `5bf229f6`.

- `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --concurrency=2`: 64/64 tasks, lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell build && pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): VERDICT command-exit 0, 0 `error TS`. `dist/index.d.ts` no longer names `toastWithUndo` or `useAssistant`.
- Narrowed vitest run: 14 app-shell test files that import or read the root entry (found by grepping the package's tests for the root `index` specifier and for `src/index.ts`), plus `product-neutral-renderer.ratchet.test.ts`: 14 files, 86 tests passed. `spec-symbol-parity.test.ts` and the console's `createdRecordPath.test.ts`, which reads `app-shell/src/index`: 2 files, 57 tests passed. The full app-shell suite is left to CI `Test UI`.
- The migration lines were compiled. A scratch `.ts` imports from the built `dist/index.d.ts` and asserts that each of the 22 FROM → TO derivations in the changeset is a real type, not `any` and not `never`: `tsc` exit 0. The control file imports `toastWithUndo` and `SettleSignalState` and fails with `TS2305 ... has no exported member` twice, as the changeset says an importer will.
- `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/console --concurrency=2`: 71/71 tasks, VERDICT command-exit 0. The tree was clean afterwards, so the sdui record did not move (app-shell is outside the record).

## Gates

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 29 commands. 28 exit 0. `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main` exits 1 (see Acceptance notes). `--ran` with every exit code recorded: 29 run, 0 NOT MEASURED.
- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main`: exit 0 (0 anchored files in the change set).
- `ui/scripts/check-doc-links.mjs`: exit 0. The links in the rewritten guide resolve.
- `ui/scripts/check-readme-exports.mjs`: exit 1, but only on 72 self-imports of packages outside app-shell's build closure that this container did not build (`cli`, `plugin-ai`, `plugin-gantt`, `plugin-map`, …). No app-shell README line is among them. CI runs it on a full build.
- `ui/scripts/check-doc-snippet-types.mjs`: NOT MEASURED locally, because it needs nearly every ui package built. The guide's six `tsx` fences are byte-identical to main (`cmp` over the extracted fences), and the names they import (`AppShell`, `MinimalAppShellProps`) stay exported. CI runs it.
- Full dogfood battery (owed because of the `!` in the title): NOT MEASURED. Reason: it runs once on the final head, and this branch merges `origin/main` only after the i18n batch PR #26158 has merged (it also edits `src/index.ts`) and the seat gives the go.

## Acceptance notes

- **ADR-0087 gate red, and it is the gate's gap, not this diff's.** The disposition that fits is `not-required (runtime-export-retired @object-ui/app-shell#NAME, ...)`. The gate refuses all 54 operands at predicate 1 with "no workspace manifest at fbb75998ba0e is named `@object-ui/app-shell`": `PACKAGE_ROOTS` in `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` is `['packages', 'apps', 'examples']`, while `pnpm-workspace.yaml` also lists `ui/packages/*`, `ui/apps/*` and `ui/examples/*`. A local probe that added the three `ui/` roots (restored afterwards, `git diff HEAD` empty) took predicate 1 to green for all 54, and left 16 refused at predicate 2 ("the declaration of NAME cannot be located at the merge base"): aliases (`MetadataPageShell`), shim re-exports (`RecentItemInput`, `RecentTextItem`) and `.tsx` declarations (`PreviewBadgeProps`, `RecordFormPageProps`, `StudioDesignSurfaceProps`, …). No other disposition fits honestly: `no-migration-prescription` would hold only on a detector miss, because the body prescribes 54 rewrites. Fixing the gate is outside this card's file surface; the seat decides how to route it.
- `toastWithUndo` and `ToastWithUndoOptions` have no caller inside the package either, so `chrome/toast-helpers.ts` is now dead code. It is left in place, because the card retires exports, not modules.
- Some retired types describe names the entry still exports, for example `MetadataPreviewProps` for `registerMetadataPreview` and `StudioCanvasPreviewProps` for `registerStudioCanvasPreview`. They are retired because the card's rule is "no caller, retire". The changeset gives each a compiled derivation from the name that stays.
- Consumers outside this repository (cloud, hotcrm, npm) were not measured.
- `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` in the card does not exist on main under `ui/`. The file the card quotes ("Minimal application rendering engine", five exports, "~50KB") is `ui/docs/app-shell-extraction-guide.md`, which calls itself the architecture guide. That file is the one rewritten here, and it keeps its name because `ui/scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs` and `check-doc-snippet-types.test.ts` list it.
